name: Ruined Mansion
desc1: This sorry, ruined mansion once might have been of good quality, but
desc2: is in extreme disrepair. Holes in the rotten floor gape at you, and
desc3: crumbling paint peels off of the walls. Broken furniture and household
desc4: belongings litter the floor, and there is evidence that someone lives
desc5: here even now, as a filthy nest-like pile of rags sits in one corner.
desc6: The rotten entrance door leads out to the east.
